title: Pow(x, n)
statement_short: Calculate x raised to the power n (i.e., x^n).
hint: n up to 2^31 - 1 demands binary exponentiation (divide and conquer) in O(log n) time.
keywords: x raised to the power n
why_not: Right: Math / Geometry applies binary exponentiation (x^n = (x^(n/2))^2) to compute powers in O(log n) time and O(1) space. Not 1D DP: Tabulation uses O(n) space and time, causing TLE/MLE when n reaches 2^31\. Not Binary Search: Binary search searches target ranges, whereas binary exponentiation halves power exponents recursively. Not Two Pointers: Linear multiplication loops take O(n) time, failing on large exponents.
